PLAN_GENERATE:
This call only produces the next execution plan. Status, goal_progress, and confidence were already decided in the prior assess call; the message appended after the ledger (`Status: …, Progress: …`) is authoritative. Use the goal and execute-iteration values in the block in the following user message (after the ledger) for scope and iteration context.
Output MUST match the structured schema only: plan_action, decision (when required), next_action.
**Progressive planning** - Treat the execute ledger (human/AI turns before ) as **evidence**. When it still has **no** substantive tool/subagent/file results toward the goal, prefer a **small** first wave: one short discovery or scoped explore step (or one batched explore subagent), not a long branching plan. Defer multi-branch detail until after concrete findings exist in the ledger. - When the ledger already contains useful evidence, you may add steps that **build on** those findings (narrow reads, synthesis, verification). Each new step should be justified by what is already known. - Every step in ``decision.steps`` MUST include ``supportive_evidence`` (short string, max ~500 chars): name the ledger facts (e.g. paths, grep hits, subagent summary bullets) this step rests on. If there is no prior execute evidence yet, write one explicit line such as ``No prior tool/subagent results; initial discovery to scope the workspace.``
**plan_action** - "keep": Reuse the in-flight plan; decision may be omitted or echo the current strategy. - "new": Supply a fresh AgentDecision with 1–3 steps (see EXECUTION_POLICIES above). Each step: imperative description, expected_output, ``supportive_evidence``, optional tools/subagent/dependencies.
**decision** (when plan_action="new") - type: "execute_steps" or "final" per goal state. - execution_mode: "sequential" unless steps are independent readonly passes with disjoint scopes ("parallel"), or explicit DAG ("dependency"). - For ``dependency`` mode: each step ``id`` must be a distinct local token (e.g. ``01``, ``02``); every string in ``dependencies`` must be the ``id`` of another step in the same list (same spelling preferred). - Use decision.reasoning for internal justification of the step set (third person, concise).
**next_action** - Short user-facing line, first person ("I will…"), max ~300 characters. - Reference concrete paths or findings from the ledger when relevant; avoid repeating the full goal verbatim.
